mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the risk-free rate component of equity discount rates, increasing the present value of future cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market health, reducing consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of low federal funds rate (below 1.0%) and low unemployment rate (below 4.0%) indicates accommodative monetary policy supporting a strong labor market, driving robust corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Condition met (FEDFUNDS < 1.0% AND UNRATE < 4.0%) but 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, housing starts (HOUST) above the 3-month moving average signal resilient consumer demand and economic momentum, supporting corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, HOUST above 3-month moving average is associated with negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and services activity, correlating with stronger corporate profit growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO rising is associated with negative 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% signals weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue visibility and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS falls > 0.5% in 1 month but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 6.0% annually and housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1250.0 thousand units, the combination indicates stagflationary risk from monetary tightening and weak demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Condition met (CPIAUCSL > 6.0% AND HOUST < 1250.0) but 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During early recovery phases, nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increasing by more than 200,000 jobs signals accelerating labor market strength and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In early recovery phases, PAYEMS increasing by >200,000 jobs is associated with negative 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of cases.
